request.prompt: A single RimWorld ground-cover plant sprite, the qirra mat, seen from above on a transparent background and filling most of the square frame. The mat is a thin, flat crust of thick, fleshy, irregular rust-maroon scale-plates fitted tightly together like dried canyon clay, lying nearly flush with the ground. Narrow cracked-clay-like seams separate the plates, and the plates overlap only shallowly in one low tier. Every plate rim is low and rests against the ground. The mat rises only slightly toward a recessed, wet, glistening centre, where a darker maroon sheen and restrained wet highlights gather. Outside the centre the surface is matte and clay-dusted, with painterly visible brush texture and subtle variation between red-brown, rust and deep maroon. The plates have plain, subdued edges and the whole mat forms one alien crust in this one rust-maroon colour family, with every part of the plant coloured red-brown. A thin clean dark outline traces the silhouette and the plate contours. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, hand-painted look, transparent background, no cast scene, the mat alone.
